candidates.label: The pleading woman's complaint heard by Allah who hears the whole dialogue
candidates.definition: In 58:1: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah; and Allah hears your dialogue, indeed Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: قَدۡ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوۡلَ ٱلَّتِي تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِي زَوۡجِهَا وَتَشۡتَكِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسۡمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Divine hearing of a domestic grievance.

candidates.label: Zihar repudiated because mothers are only those who gave birth
candidates.definition: In 58:2: Those who pronounce zihar among you to separate from their wives, they are not consequently their mothers; their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them; and indeed they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood, but indeed Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمۡۖ إِنۡ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي وَلَدۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَزُورٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Graduated expiation ladder for retracting zihar within Allah's limits
candidates.definition: In 58:3-4: Those who pronounce zihar and then wish to go back on what they said must free a slave before they touch one another; and he who does not find one then a fast for two months consecutively; and he who is unable then the feeding of sixty poor persons; those are the limits set by Allah.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ شَهۡرَيۡنِ مُتَتَابِعَيۡنِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَسۡتَطِعۡ فَإِطۡعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسۡكِينٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Deeds enumerated by Allah though forgotten by their doers
candidates.definition: In 58:6: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did; Allah had enumerated it while they forgot it, and Allah is over all things Witness.

evidence.excerpt: يَوۡمَ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعٗا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ أَحۡصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Private-conversation formula establishing knowledge-based presence
candidates.definition: In 58:7: There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them, and no less than that and no more except that He is with them wherever they are.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجۡوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمۡ وَلَا خَمۡسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكۡثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كَانُواْۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Private counsel redirected from sin and aggression to righteousness and piety
candidates.definition: In 58:9: O you who have believed, when you converse privately do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety, and fear Allah to whom you will be gathered.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا تَنَٰجَيۡتُمۡ فَلَا تَتَنَٰجَوۡاْ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِ وَمَعۡصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَٰجَوۡاْ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Birr and taqwa as counsel content.

candidates.label: Satanic whispering meant to grieve believers yet powerless without permission
candidates.definition: In 58:10: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah; and upon Allah let the believers rely.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ لِيَحۡزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيۡسَ بِضَآرِّهِمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Assembly courtesy answered by divine elevation of believers and the knowledgeable
candidates.definition: In 58:11: O you who have believed, when you are told space yourselves in assemblies then make space, Allah will make space for you; and when you are told arise then arise, Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge by degrees.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمۡ تَفَسَّحُواْ فِي ٱلۡمَجَٰلِسِ فَٱفۡسَحُواْ يَفۡسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُواْ فَٱنشُزُواْ يَرۡفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ دَرَجَٰتٖۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Charity before private consultation with concession and reaffirmed obligations
candidates.definition: In 58:12-13: When you wish to privately consult the Messenger present before your consultation a charity, that is better for you and purer, but if you find not the means then indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful; have you feared to present charities, then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you then establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَٰجَيۡتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَةٗۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ وَأَطۡهَرُۚ فَإِن لَّمۡ تَجِدُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: ءَأَشۡفَقۡتُمۡ أَن تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَٰتٖۚ فَإِذۡ لَمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: False oaths used as cover to avert people from Allah's way
candidates.definition: In 58:16: They took their false oaths as a cover so they averted people from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

evidence.excerpt: ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Satan's mastery producing forgetfulness of remembrance and the losing party
candidates.definition: In 58:19: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah; those are the party of Satan; unquestionably the party of Satan they will be the losers.

evidence.excerpt: ٱسۡتَحۡوَذَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمۡ ذِكۡرَ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Written decree that Allah and His messengers will surely overcome
candidates.definition: In 58:21: Allah has written, I will surely overcome, I and My messengers; indeed Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

evidence.excerpt: كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغۡلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِيٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Loyalty overriding kinship with faith inscribed and mutual pleasure as the successful party
candidates.definition: In 58:22: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred; those He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him, and We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they abide eternally; Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him, those are the party of Allah, unquestionably the party of Allah they are the successful.

evidence.excerpt: لَّا تَجِدُ قَوۡمٗا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنۡ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ إِخۡوَٰنَهُمۡ أَوۡ عَشِيرَتَهُمۡۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٖ مِّنۡهُۖ وَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱللَّهِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
